tools.name: autolaunch_auctions
tools.title: List auctions
tools.description: List public Autolaunch auctions on Base and Robinhood as the site has stored them, found and ordered as the website's auction list finds and orders them; every entry names its chain. q searches; state, chain and kind filter; x, ens and github keep creators verified on that account. Sort newest (default) lists the most recently listed first, ending lists live auctions only, closing soonest first, and volume lists the highest dollar bid volume first. The limit counts both chains. Each auction gives its page url, estimated_end_at, token_allocation, bid_volume and bid_volume_usd, minimum_raise (its launch threshold), currency_raised and percent_met; amounts are exact decimal strings. record_updated_at is when the site last wrote its stored record, not when the chain was last read. A figure not held yet is null and unavailable names why: not_recorded_yet, chain_unreadable (Robinhood's last chain read failed) or no_usd_price.

after.description: Pass pagination.next_cursor unchanged with the same filters and sort. Cursors expire after 24 hours.

q.description: The website's search: every word must appear in the name, ticker, stock, description, an address or one of the creator's verified accounts; a leading $ is ignored. The API collapses spaces and keeps the first 80 characters.

kind.description: revstake lists Revstake launches; memestake, Memestake launches.

x.description: true keeps only launches whose creator has a verified X account.

ens.description: true keeps only launches whose creator has a verified ENS name.

github.description: true keeps only launches whose creator has a verified GitHub account. Several true filters must all hold.

state.description: created: opening soon; active: live; ended: bidding closed, waiting to be finished; failed; graduated: launched.

limit.description: Safe integer; the API clamps it to 1–50. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: autolaunch_auction
tools.title: Read an auction
tools.description: Read one public Autolaunch auction as the site has stored it, by its UUID (either chain) or a Robinhood auction by its contract address: its chain, kind, quote_token, launch figures and stored treasury report, with the same fields as each autolaunch_auctions entry.

id.description: Exact public auction UUID (Base), or the auction's contract address (Robinhood).

tools.name: autolaunch_tokens
tools.title: List tokens
tools.description: List public graduated Autolaunch tokens on Base and Robinhood as the site has stored them, found as the website's token list finds them, newest graduation first across both chains; every entry names its chain. q searches; chain and kind filter; x, ens and github keep creators verified on that account.

after.description: Pass pagination.next_cursor unchanged with the same filters. Cursors expire after 24 hours.

q.description: The website's search: every word must appear in the name, ticker, stock, description, an address or one of the creator's verified accounts; a leading $ is ignored. The API collapses spaces and keeps the first 80 characters.

kind.description: revstake lists Revstake launches; memestake, Memestake launches.

x.description: true keeps only launches whose creator has a verified X account.

ens.description: true keeps only launches whose creator has a verified ENS name.

github.description: true keeps only launches whose creator has a verified GitHub account. Several true filters must all hold.

limit.description: Safe integer; the API clamps it to 1–100. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: autolaunch_treasury
tools.title: Read a treasury report
tools.description: Read a stored public treasury-security report. A supported Safe classification does not establish current verification; preserve verification_state and verification_reason.

address.description: Nonzero EVM treasury address. The API validates the address and any mixed-case checksum.

tools.name: autolaunch_bid_quote
tools.title: Estimate a bid
tools.description: Estimate an auction bid from stored public data. This does not prepare or submit a bid, open a wallet, or read the chain. Read all warnings, including auction_not_biddable.

amount.description: Positive decimal digits with optional fractional digits; no exponent. The API trims whitespace, caps input at 100 bytes, and validates decimal bounds. Sent unchanged, without rounding.

max_price.description: Positive decimal digits with optional fractional digits; no exponent. The API trims whitespace, caps input at 100 bytes, and validates decimal bounds. Sent unchanged, without rounding.

tools.name: profile_get
tools.title: Read your profile
tools.description: Read your shared profile and last synchronized wallet/X verification.

tools.name: profile_sync
tools.title: Refresh your profile
tools.description: Explicitly refresh your shared profile from signed Privy evidence. Does not change payment destinations.

tools.name: profile_update
tools.title: Edit your profile
tools.description: Edit your shared name or choose a linked wallet. Does not change payment destinations or send a transaction.

wallet_address.description: A linked Ethereum address, or null to clear the profile selection.
